# Cohen Pert

> Personal site of Cohen Pert — young entrepreneur, builder, and operator focused on AI automation and business systems. Founder of The Pert Group.

Cohen Pert builds AI-powered systems that help businesses automate operations and scale faster. The site covers his background, the organizations he runs, featured projects, his journey, and how to get in touch.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Cohen Pert, his work, projects, and contact info.
- [About / Founder Intro](/#about): Who Cohen is, key metrics, and links to The Pert Group and LinkedIn.
- [What I Run](/#company): Organizations and ventures Cohen leads, including The Pert Group.
- [Featured Projects](/#work): Real estate, food business OS, investment fund, and other builds.
- [Journey / Timeline](/#timeline): Milestones across Cohen's entrepreneurial path.
- [How I Work](/#how): Operating principles and approach to building.
- [Contact](/#contact): Book a call or reach out directly.
